name: Psychometric Epistemic Assurance blinded pilot
ablation: Compare TECT with versus without PEA using the same tasks and budgets
primary_question: Can psychometrically calibrated evidence and validation measures improve accuracy, reproducibility and interpretability of scoped TECT assurance decisions?
primary_endpoint: Held-out false acceptance rate at matched coverage
blinding: Independent adjudicators receive randomized outputs without condition identifiers; assess residual unblinding
analysis: Paired task comparisons; cluster-aware uncertainty by task/source; report denominators, missing labels, unresolved cases, exclusions, failures and all arms
